Nice experience 👍
Mar 2026 • Family
Had a really nice dining experience at this Japanese restaurant. The atmosphere was calm, clean, and very authentic. The food was fresh and beautifully presented — especially the sushi and sashimi, which tasted very natural and high quality.
The service was also excellent. The staff were friendly, attentive, and made us feel very comfortable throughout the meal.
